description: This file defines a Next.js page component for rendering individual blog posts. It includes static generation configuration, metadata, and the main React component that displays a blog post based on a URL parameter.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Returns static parameters for pre-rendering blog post pages, specifically a single slug 'welcome-to-xperthrivr'.

methods.name: BlogPostPage
methods.description: Async React component that renders the blog post page based on URL params. It transforms the slug into a title and displays placeholder content.
